field_guide.id: Stable ID = client-<sheet row number>. Use this to link anything to a client.
field_guide.sheet_row: Row in the original Google Sheet, for tracing back.
field_guide.people: Filled only when one client entry covers several people (each with own email/phone/license).
field_guide.brokerage_license_no: Brokerage FSRA / brokerage licence number as written in the sheet.
field_guide.agent_license_no: Individual agent licence number as written in the sheet.
field_guide.other_ids: Numbers in the sheet whose label (brokerage vs agent) was unclear.
field_guide.photo_notes: Notes from the Photos / Photo Status column (e.g. client doesn't want images).
field_guide.assets: Images from the sheet, full resolution. photo = profile photo (column J), footer = post footer banner (column N), logos = brokerage/brand logos (column O; several when the client uses more than one). 'file' is relative to this folder.
field_guide.raw_client_details: The client-details cell exactly as written, for anything the structured fields miss.
